description: This file defines the RotateImageEffect class for rotating images within Drupal, including configuration, effect application, dimension transformation, and form building.

classes.name: RotateImageEffect
classes.description: A class that provides image rotation effects, including configuration, effect application, dimension transformation, and form handling within Drupal.

methods.name: applyEffect
methods.description: Applies rotation effect to the given image, with optional randomization of degrees.

methods.name: transformDimensions
methods.description: Calculates new image dimensions after rotation based on configuration.

methods.name: getSummary
methods.description: Returns a summary of the rotation effect configuration.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Provides default configuration values for the rotation effect.

methods.name: buildConfigurationForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for setting rotation parameters.

methods.name: validateConfigurationForm
methods.description: Validates the configuration form inputs, especially the background color.

methods.name: submitConfigurationForm
methods.description: Handles submission of the configuration form, saving user inputs.
